annotations.title: Validate a business tax ID (any supported country)

description: Validate a business tax or registry ID for any supported country with the deepest check available for it. Norway (organisation number), Finland (Y-tunnus or VAT), France (SIREN, SIRET or VAT), Ireland (CRO company number) and Taiwan (unified business number) are checked live against the official open registry: legal name, status (active, dissolved, bankrupt, struck off and others), address, key dates, the source with its licence and the date of the data, verification_level "official_registry" and a pass/review/fail assessment with reasons. Ireland comes from the CRO daily snapshot, not a live query. Dominican Republic RNC (9 digits) is checked against our copy of the DGII RNC registry file, refreshed from the file the DGII publishes daily (legal and trade name, status, activity, payment regime); an 11-digit cédula of a natural person gets the format check only, without any name. Chile RUT is checked against our copy of the SII register of legal entities (nómina de personas jurídicas, refreshed a few times a year: see source.data_as_of): name, legal form, start date and término de giro (closure = fail). Canada BN (9 digits, or with a program account such as RT0001) is checked against our copy of the Corporations Canada federal corporations data, refreshed daily (Open Government Licence – Canada): name, status, registered office, dates; it covers federal corporations only, so a BN not found is review, never fail. For sole proprietorships (Norway ENK, French entrepreneurs individuels, Finnish sole traders) only the status is returned, without name or address. Peru, Mexico, Colombia and Costa Rica are answered by the same lookups as their own tools. Every other covered country (about 45, including EU VAT numbers, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Australia, India and Japan) gets the offline format check with verification_level "format", which never returns pass.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "NO", "FI", "FR", "IE", "TW", "DO", "CL", "CA", "DE", "PE". "EL" is accepted for Greece and "UK" for the United Kingdom.

id.description: The ID as written, with or without the country prefix, spaces, dots or dashes, e.g. "974761076", "1003521-5", "FR90130004955", "98788", "03741302".

id_type.description: Optional ID type when the country has several, e.g. "siren", "siret", "vat", "ytunnus", "cro", "orgnr", "ubn", "rnc", "cedula", "rut", "bn". Detected from the input when omitted.
